title: ValueSim: Generating Backstories to Model Individual Value Systems
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the accuracy of simulating an individual's responses to survey questions about their personal moral and religious values. This is based on the World Values Survey (WVS) dataset, specifically within a reorganized category called the 'Moral-Religious Framework' which combines questions on religious and ethical values.
findings: The proposed ValueSim framework significantly improves the accuracy of simulating human responses on questions related to moral and religious values compared to baseline methods (Full Info and RAG). For all tested language models, ValueSim achieved a lower Mean Absolute Error (MAE) in the 'Moral & Religious' value dimension, indicating a better alignment with individual human values in this domain.
